verdict.rationale: Mercury Books ships a built-in AI assistant, Command, which users can ask questions about their finances or directly hand off bookkeeping tasks like writing journal entries, categorization, and chart-of-accounts organization in plain language. This is vendor-documented as a core, currently-available feature, not just a roadmap item (the MCP/agent-to-agent layer is separate and future). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of Command's task-delegation reliability, and clarity on scope/limits of what tasks it can fully execute versus assist with (the vendor's own 'not autopilot' caveat suggests some human oversight is still needed).
